initial.name: lvpaopao
initial.description: Search Lvpaopao dramas, read details and actual episode numbers through the configured Windows WeChat target. status reports readiness. When the trusted local download lane is enabled, download_first_episode copies only an authorized first episode and verifies its bytes and hash. Results do not grant content reuse rights.

srcAppId.description: detail/episodes/download_first_episode: source AppID returned by search.

dramaId.description: detail/episodes/download_first_episode: source drama identifier, kept as a string.

start.description: episodes: first requested positive episode number.

count.description: episodes: bounded requested count. The result reports only actual returned numbers.

outputDir.description: download_first_episode only: defaults to downloads/lvpaopao in this Session workspace. Relative paths stay inside that workspace; an external absolute path requires full file access.
